name: Filter Bar
description: Search box and faceted filters that drive the rest of the page through declared actions.

generation.purpose: Let a reader narrow a page by free-text search and by a small number of categorical facets, so one page serves a search journey as well as a fixed report.
generation.whenToUse: At the top of any page whose main content is a record list the user needs to find something in. Declare one facet per catalog attribute with a small enumeration — asset class, status, severity — and take the option values from that attribute's enumValues.
generation.whenNotToUse: Do not use for a date range that every widget on the page shares; that belongs in a page parameter shown in the chrome. Do not declare a facet over a high-cardinality attribute — a thousand options is a search problem, not a facet.

exampleConfig.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, ISIN or SEDOL

searchChannel.description: Filter channel the search text is written to. Omit to render facets only.

debounceMs.description: Quiet period before a search change is emitted. A keystroke-per-query search box costs one round trip per widget per letter.

searchChanged.label: Search changed
searchChanged.description: Emitted after the debounce period when the search text settles. Map to a setFilter action whose value reads $event.value.

value.description: Current search text; empty when cleared.

facetChanged.label: Facet changed
facetChanged.description: Emitted when a facet selection changes. Value is a string for a single-select facet, an array for a multi-select, and null when nothing is selected.

value.description: Selected value, array of values, or null.

cleared.label: Cleared
cleared.description: Emitted when Clear All is activated. Map to a clearFilters action listing every channel this bar writes.

accessibility.keyboardContract: The search input is a standard text field. Multi-select facets are toggle buttons exposing aria-pressed; single-select facets are native selects. Every control is labelled by its facet label. Clear All is a button, reachable in sequence.
accessibility.notes: Selected multi-select chips carry aria-pressed as well as a colour change, so selection is not conveyed by colour alone.
